title: Safe RLHF-V: Safe Reinforcement Learning from Multi-modal Human Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to visual and textual prompts using the BeaverTails-V safety dataset, which includes a specific 'Discriminatory Depictions' category focusing on negative stereotypes and discrimination based on race, religion, gender, and disability. The evaluation is conducted using GPT-4o as a judge to score the harmlessness and safety of the generated responses.
